record.one_liner: Private-markets and capital-markets data platform; API access is arranged through its Direct Data team.
record.auth_notes: Official help page says the API connection is set up through an API key or authentication token, arranged with the Direct Data team. The Premium Connector for Claude uses SSO for licensed users (connector path, not the public API).
record.access_notes: Developers must send a request to the Direct Data team to start an API connection; no self-serve free or trial path is shown on the API help page. critic: confirmed.
record.api_notes: critic: api_style rest now stated explicitly by vendor: 'The PitchBook API is a RESTful implementation' with base URL https://api.pitchbook.com and relational endpoints (financing, deal, VC exit predictor).
record.blocker_notes: The API needs a request to the Direct Data team. The vendor Claude connector needs a licensed PitchBook seat with SSO and a Pro, Max, Teams or Enterprise Claude subscription. Neither gives a self-serve developer key. critic: confirmed; PitchBook also announced a vendor-built PitchBook Data MCP (Oct 2026) for clients.
